minia.name: Multi-agent AI Chief of Staff (Minia)
minia.description: Context was scattered across Gmail, CRM, meetings and documents, multiplied by several companies. An orchestrator agent reachable on Telegram, WhatsApp and Discord, backed by specialised AI staff and a sourced memory where every fact is tied to its evidence. Read-first: any sensitive external write goes through human approval.
minia.problem: Every file started from scratch: context scattered across Gmail, CRM, meetings and documents, forgotten follow-ups, decisions made on incomplete information. All of it multiplied by several companies.
minia.solution: An orchestrator agent reachable on Telegram, WhatsApp and Discord, backed by specialised AI staff and a sourced, versioned memory where every fact is tied to its evidence. Connectors for Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Monday, Sellsy, Fireflies and Pennylane. Read-first: any sensitive external write goes through human approval.

prospection.name: Automated multi-channel prospecting
prospection.description: Automatic lead enrichment, per-channel personalised outreach (email, LinkedIn, phone), automatic ICP targeting.
prospection.problem: Lead generation depended on whatever time the sales team could spare. Manual targeting, generic messaging, follow-ups left to chance.
prospection.solution: Automatic lead enrichment, computed ICP targeting, then per-channel personalised sequences — email, LinkedIn, phone — orchestrated in n8n with AI agents doing the writing.

datahub.name: Data centralisation & AI dashboards
datahub.description: Data warehouse wired to every existing tool, one central management interface, AI-enriched monitoring.
datahub.problem: Data lived in a dozen tools that did not talk to each other. Every business question meant a manual export and a hand-made reconciliation.
datahub.solution: A data warehouse wired to every existing tool, one central management interface, and AI-enriched monitoring that surfaces anomalies before they turn into incidents.

orchestrateur.name: Multi-team Telegram orchestrator
orchestrateur.description: A central Telegram agent coordinating specialised sub-agents — HR, marketing, prospecting, management — without hiring a coordinator.
orchestrateur.problem: Coordinating HR, marketing, prospecting and management called for a full-time coordinator the agency did not want to hire.
orchestrateur.solution: A central Telegram agent routes requests to sub-agents specialised per function, tracks progress and escalates what is stuck. One interface for the founder.

support.name: 24/7 AI customer support
support.description: Conversational agent handling order tracking, returns and FAQ, with smart hand-off to a human.
support.problem: Ticket volume grew with the catalogue. Order tracking, returns and FAQ took up most of an eight-person team's time.
support.solution: A conversational agent on a RAG document base, wired to WhatsApp and Zendesk. It handles routine requests end to end and escalates to a human as soon as the context leaves its scope.

rh.name: HR process automation
rh.description: Full recruiting pipeline: AI CV screening, pre-qualification, interview scheduling and onboarding.
rh.problem: CV screening, pre-qualification and interview logistics ate the HR team's week. Average time-to-hire sat at 45 days.
rh.solution: A fully automated pipeline: NLP CV reading and scoring, asynchronous pre-qualification, interview scheduling in Google Calendar and onboarding triggered in Notion.

stocks.name: Predictive inventory management
stocks.description: AI demand forecasting wired into the ERP, with automatic replenishment and stockout alerts.
stocks.problem: Forecasting ran on Excel, history and gut feel. The result: stockouts on fast movers and overstock on everything else.
stocks.solution: A Python demand-forecasting model wired to the SAP ERP over a real-time API. Replenishment triggered automatically, stockout alerts raised before the shelf empties.

reporting.name: Automated multi-platform reporting
reporting.description: Weekly reports generated automatically by consolidating data from 8 platforms — Shopify, Meta Ads, GA4 and the rest.
reporting.problem: Consolidating figures from eight platforms took two days a week. The report landed after the decision had already been made.
reporting.solution: Automatic collection through each platform's API, consolidation in n8n, formatting and commentary written by GPT-4, published to Notion every Monday morning.

telavie.name: Télavie
telavie.description: Unified telemedicine and healthcare facility management platform, hosted on HDS-certified infrastructure. A coherent system for patients, practitioners and administrators, with real-time exchanges.
telavie.outcome: Telemedicine and administration in a single system
telavie.problem: Healthcare providers juggled a telemedicine tool, a management system and scattered conversations. Nothing talked to anything, and health-data hosting brought its own constraints.
telavie.solution: One platform covering both telemedicine and facility management, with three coherent spaces: patient, practitioner, administrator. Next.js and Prisma on PostgreSQL, client-side data kept fresh with SWR, real-time exchanges over Socket, hosted on HDS-certified infrastructure.

talentfindr.name: TalentFindr
talentfindr.description: AI sourcing platform: search across 800M+ profiles, automatic relevance scoring, verified contact details and multi-channel LinkedIn, email and WhatsApp sequences. Copilot mode, or autopilot with KAIA, the agent that sources, reaches out and follows up on its own. GDPR compliant, hosted in the EU.
talentfindr.outcome: 1,500+ recruiters, agencies and consultancies across 10+ countries
talentfindr.problem: Sourcing is still the most time-consuming part of recruiting: search, verify contact details, write, follow up, then start over on the next role.
talentfindr.solution: An AI sourcing platform across 800M+ profiles: relevance scoring, verified contact details, multi-channel LinkedIn, email and WhatsApp sequences, unified inbox and pipeline management. Two modes: copilot, where the recruiter stays in control, and autopilot with KAIA, the agent that sources, reaches out and follows up on its own. GDPR compliant, hosted in the EU.

growit.name: GrowIt
growit.description: Multi-agent AI prospecting system: autonomous lead identification, extraction and qualification with direct CRM injection.
growit.outcome: From raw lead to CRM with no human step
growit.problem: Identify a target, extract contact details, qualify it, then key it into the CRM: four manual steps repeated on every single lead.
growit.solution: A multi-agent system where each agent owns one step of the chain. The lead comes in raw and lands qualified in the CRM, with no manual pass.

mojo.name: Mojo APP
mojo.description: Intelligent WhatsApp assistant that structures client relations around the clock: conversation management, order taking and schedule organisation.
mojo.outcome: Conversations, orders and calendar run from WhatsApp
mojo.problem: Customer conversations land on WhatsApp at any hour. Orders get lost in the thread, appointments end up noted somewhere else.
mojo.solution: A WhatsApp assistant that holds the conversation, records orders and books appointments in the calendar. The customer keeps their usual channel; the structure happens behind it.

automations.client: Multi-sector — e-commerce, healthcare, real estate, SaaS
automations.name: +2,000 automations deployed
automations.description: n8n & Make workflows deployed across e-commerce, healthcare, real estate and SaaS. Fewer manual operations, faster growth.
automations.problem: The same picture shows up from one sector to the next: repetitive tasks held together by hand because the tools in place do not talk to each other.
automations.solution: Over 2,000 n8n and Make workflows deployed across e-commerce, healthcare, real estate and SaaS. Connecting the existing tools rather than replacing them, with the same routine: map it, then ship it.
